note: `hail` gives the uniform Cauchy property (Confluence) of the scalar-free density and the singleton functions, and `markets` gives their measurability; the finite-polynomial form of the source formula, with its grouping by supports and inventories, and the resulting uniform Cauchy property and Haar integrability of its coefficients, are not stated at these lines.

lemma hail (m:ℕ)(hr:ψ d≤ m) (t:Motion)(x:∀ i,Site (A.B.a.S.side i p)): Confluence (fun n=> (show Config G (A.B.a.S.side m p)→ℂ from indexX (Lx! n) d (f n) p y x t m)) ∧ ∀ i:Box (A.B.a.S.side m p),Confluence (fun n=> (show Config G (A.B.a.S.side m p)→ℂ from Ktone (Lx! n) d (f n) p y x t m i)):=by
    let u:= U m; let H:=V' m; let ξ:ℂ:= alto (Lx! 0).path m d; obtain ⟨h,c,hc,hM⟩:= J.grow hG b T hx hz d he y m hr
    have he' :∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∃ K: Keeper (H n).p (H n).activities, Along (H n) (D m p).orient ∧ (u n).Format 0 (hol G) (H n)∧ Coin.uses (c n)=capture (u n) K:= (J.helmet.sails.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop m)).mono (fun n hn=> ⟨_, ((J.branch n).notices (fun i=> Boutique.brochure Y i p hz) (he.height.trans hr) hn).alongside.sym, (he.second n (hr.trans hn)|>.format _ hr hn _),hM n hn⟩)
    let T:=localSection G d
    exact ⟨revive t (x m) (recto T H he' hc h) ξ,fun i=> revive t (x m) (towers H he' hc ((puff t (x m)).symm i)) ξ⟩

proof_context.conclusion: `hail` shows the density data `indexX` and every singleton function `Ktone` at level `m` are `Confluence` (Cauchy) in `n`.

snippet.text: lemma markets (m:ℕ)(hm:ψ d≤ m) (t:Motion)(x:∀ i,Site (A.B.a.S.side i p)): ∀ᶠ n in atTop, Measurable (indexX (Lx! n) d (f n) p y x t m) ∧ ∀ i:Box (A.B.a.S.side m p),Measurable (Ktone (Lx! n) d (f n) p y x t m i):=(J.helmet.sails.eventually (eventually_ge_atTop m)).mono fun n hn=> boreal (V' m n) (hol G) (localSection G d) _ _ _ (f:=U m n) ((he.second n (hm.trans hn)).format _ hm hn _)

proof_context.conclusion: `markets` shows they are measurable eventually in `n`.
